subject: SteadyHub — VAT ID validation and reverse-charge treatment for Redwood invoices
messages:
From: Oliver Price <oliver.price@steadyhub.co.uk>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: SteadyHub Accounting <accounts@steadyhub.co.uk>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Tax treatment for Redwood invoices — VAT ID and reverse-charge question

Hi Rishi,

We're preparing to onboard Redwood for usage across our EU entities. Quick question on invoicing: we are a VAT-registered B2B purchaser in the UK/EU and would expect the reverse-charge to apply.

Attached is our VAT certificate — can you confirm:
- whether Redwood will validate the VAT ID and apply reverse-charge (i.e. issue net invoices),
- what evidence you require from us (VIES screenshot, company registration address, signed PO?), and
- whether your invoice will include a specific reverse-charge footnote for local accounting?

We also need to know if Redwood can send invoices to our EU entity (SteadyHub Ltd.) rather than the global billing entity.

Thanks,

Oliver Price
Head of Finance — SteadyHub Ltd.
[Attachment: steadyhub_vat_cert.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Price <oliver.price@steadyhub.co.uk>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tax treatment for Redwood invoices — VAT ID and reverse-charge question

Hi Oliver — thanks for the certificate, and welcome.

Short answer: we can support reverse-charge (issue net invoices) provided we can validate the VAT ID (VIES) and confirm the EU billing entity details. To proceed we need:
1) VAT number confirmation + company legal name and registered address (you attached certificate, but please also confirm the billing entity email and postal address we should use).
2) A PO or signed acceptance to route invoices to SteadyHub Ltd. (if you want invoices to a specific EU entity).

Ben from Finance is cc'd — he'll confirm the internal acceptance criteria. For transparency, when we apply reverse-charge we put the following line on the invoice: "Reverse-charge — recipient liable for VAT under Council Directive 2006/112/EC" and supply net amounts.

If you prefer, we can also run the VAT number through VIES ourselves and share a validation screenshot for your records.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm billing entity name & postal address + PO number
- We validate VAT ID via VIES and confirm
- Redwood issues the next invoice net with reverse-charge note

I'll follow up internally to make sure Finance has no additional evidence requests.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Tax treatment for Redwood invoices — VAT ID and reverse-charge question

Rishi / Marissa — forwarding Oliver's cert. My take:
- We can accept reverse-charge for EU B2B provided the VAT ID validates in VIES at time of invoicing and billing entity is an EU-registered company.
- We should capture a VIES validation screenshot and store it with the invoice in our AR record.
- If the customer's entity is UK-based and they want invoices routed to a UK legal entity, ensure PO references the UK company registration number to avoid payer mismatch.

Risks/controls:
- If the VAT ID fails validation at invoice date, must charge VAT (we can't apply reverse-charge ex post).
- For larger deals where withholding or local AP teams require extra proof, request a signed 'self-billing' waiver or a brief acceptance email confirming reverse-charge responsibility.

I've attached our internal checklist and a redwood invoice template that includes the reverse-charge footnote.

Attachments: [redwood_vat_guidance_internal.pdf (pdf)]

— Ben
Finance Lead — Redwood Inference

- We will route invoices to the billing address you confirm below (we can target SteadyHub Ltd. as requested).
- For our audit trail we will store the VIES validation screenshot (we can share a copy with your AP team on request).

What we need from you to finalize:

- PO number or signed acceptance to route invoices to SteadyHub Ltd.
